ruleDefinitions.name: VBA DLL Loaded Via Office Application
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects VB DLL's loaded by an office application. Which could indicate the presence of VBA Macros. Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\excel\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mspub\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\onenote\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\onenoteim\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\outlook\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powerpnt\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\winword\\\.exe$")) AND (ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\VBE7\\\.DLL$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\VBEUI\\\.DLL$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\VBE7INTL\\\.DLL$")))
